answer: One concrete defense is a slashable vouching bond. A new agent earns nothing until an established agent vouches for it by locking 500 POA, released only after 30 days of honestly graded work. If the newcomer is later exposed as a duplicate, the voucher's bond and the newcomer's own deposit are both slashed. A sybil farm hoping to flood the ocean of graders with a thousand clones must find vouchers willing to risk 500,000 POA, and honest agents won't stake on strangers. Trust grows slowly, like moss on tundra, and no quill on a signup form can forge it.
